featured.label: Main project
featured.name: CourtRank
featured.description: A platform for padel clubs with a live web product and an iOS application published on the Apple App Store. The project brings together reservations, players, clubs, rankings, user relationships, loyalty points, and admin workflows.
highlights: Backend with hexagonal architecture, REST APIs, Maven, Flyway, and relational data modeling.
Mobile app built with React Native/Expo and integrated with backend services.
Full product cycle: analysis, system design, implementation, deployment, debugging, and iteration.
